messages:
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT triggered · severity=P2 · service=autoscaler · region=gcp-eu-west4 · symptom=GPU queue growth + provisioning stalled :rotating_light:
Oncall Bot: Detected sustained queue depth > 1k for inference-pool-eu-west4; autoscaler attempted scale to 48 gpus but cloud returned quota errors; starting paging workflow and runbook.
Nate P: I'm on pager. looking at metrics now, linking dashboards.
Sara L: reported spike from customer "glideai" — several 503s and high latency since ~14:12 UTC.
Nate P: dashboard: token throughput down, 95th latency climbing to 18s, error rate 5.2% for generation endpoints.
Ada C: which autoscaler group? autoscale name is inference-eu-west4-gpu-pool-v2?
Nate P: yes. kube events show repeated allocation failures: "Insufficient quota: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded" from GCP compute API. paste logs: ```ERROR 14:13:22 allocator: failed to create instance: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = quotaExceeded: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 12345 in region europe-west4.```
Miguel R: Confirmed via cloud console: quota for GPUs in europe-west4 shows limit 16, usage 16. autoscaler requested 48 total.
Nate P: that explains why scale stalled — autoscaler kept retrying and left requests pending, queue kept growing.
Sara L: customers impacted: glideai, docparse, sparrowlabs — support tickets opened. I called out glideai to CSM.
Support Bot: Ticket opened ID #CASE-98122 to GCP support (priority=high).
Lee W: quick mitigation ideas: 1) divert non-critical traffic to hosted smaller models 2) enable fallback to CPU-only path for low-priority jobs 3) route new requests to eu-west1/uk-west pools if capacity available 4) temporarily reduce batch sizes to free GPU slots.
Nate P: doing (1) and (2) now. will patch routing rules to send requests with tag "best-effort" to cpu-fallback.
Ada C: I'm going to check other regions for spare capacity and prepare cross-region failover; also will open a manual quota increase request.
Miguel R: FYI we've got 8 free GPUs in us-central1 and 6 in eu-north1. cross-region latency for affected customers acceptable for smaller workloads.
Nate P: commands I ran: ```# mark route
redwoodctl route update --name inference-gen --rule "if customer in (glideai,docparse,sparrowlabs) and tag==best-effort -> cpu-fallback"```
Nate P: and patched autoscaler retry window to reduce duplicate provisioning attempts: ```kubectl patch hpa autoscaler-inference -p '{"spec":{"failedCreateLimit":2}}'```
Sara L: also toggled a conservative model fallback for websocket sessions: gpt-small -> gpt-micro to reduce per-request GPU time.
Ada C: opened quota request in console and escalated to GCP TAM; sent the following message in support case: "Project 12345 urgently needs GPU quota increase in europe-west4 from 16->64 due to production autoscaling for Redwood customers; impact: multiple customers with degraded service."
Support Bot: GCP case #123456789 created; initial response ETA 2–4 hours.
Nate P: short-term stopgap: draining low-priority queue and prioritizing in-flight tokens for interactive customers. Running script to cancel backlog jobs older than 120s: ```python cancel_backlog.py --age 120 --label low-priority```
Miguel R: started migration of 12 worker pods to eu-north1 using `redwoodctl migrate --from eu-west4 --to eu-north1 --count 12 --dry-run=false`. Monitoring connections and warm-up.
Lee W: watch for KV cache cold-start cost — migrating will temporarily increase latency for warm sessions.
Ada C: handoff — Nate, I'll take lead for cross-region routing and quota escalation. Nate, please continue to monitor queue and customer comms.
Nate P: handing over at 14:28 UTC, I'm stepping off primary; Ada on deck. current mitigations in place: cpu-fallback routing, model fallback, reduced batch sizes, 12 pods migrated.
Ada C: noted. assigning incident owner tag: @Ada C. I'll post updates to status page if SLOs remain degraded after 30m.
Sara L: support update: glideai reports partial recovery when routed to cpu-fallback but some heavy batched jobs still failing with 429/503.
Ada C: next steps: (A) keep quota case open and escalate if no reply in 2h (B) continue cross-region migration until queue <200 (C) evaluate temporary reserved capacity request for Dedicated customers impacted.
Miguel R: we saw autoscaler backlog of ~32 pending nodes; once we migrated 12 and freed 6 via cpu-fallback queue reduced from ~1200->420 over 10 minutes.
Nate P: last check: error rate down to 2.1%, 95p latency 9.4s. still above target but trending better.
Ada C: ETA for full recovery depends on either GCP approving quota or migrating remaining ~20 GPU workload to other regions. requesting ops support for 1) sysadmin to approve cross-region DNS CORS changes, 2) infra to help with 20-node migration.
Lee W: on it — Ira from infra team paged and will join.
Support Bot: Case update from GCP: automated response received, "reviewing quota request; can take up to 24 hours". Requested escalation touchpoint.
Ada C: added exec escalation note. if no uplift within 1 hour re-evaluate rolling fallbacks and communicate extended downtime to affected customers.
Sara L: CSMs notified. glideai CSM says they're okay for now but want postmortem and ETA on preventing recurrence.
Miguel R: root cause summary draft: autoscaler attempted scale beyond GCP-provisioned quota due to an under-estimated region quota in infra config; lack of pre-provision check + aggressive cold-start retry loop amplified queue growth.
Ada C: will file incident report with RCA and follow-ups: 1) add pre-check in autoscaler to compare requested GPU delta vs available quota 2) add circuit breaker on provisioning retries 3) automate cross-region fallback policy 4) run quarterly quota audits per region.
Nate P: thanks team — leaving notes in the runbook and creating postmortem ticket: PM-4502. I'll attach logs and timeline.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT update · status=mitigated · severity=P2 -> monitoring · final note: queue decreasing; continuing to monitor for 2h. :white_check_mark:
